name: Hattie Eaton
bio: Miss Hattie Eaton, sister of the Eaton brothers, came with her parents in April 1885 to spend the summer at the logging camp. She returned to the Bad Lands for the summer of 1886.

moments.label: Arrived to spend the summer at the logging camp

mentions: Mr. and Mrs. and Miss Hattie Eaton parents and sister of the Eaton boys, came in Monday evening and for the summer will make their headquarters at the logging camp. Mr. Eaton reported that while we…
Mr. and Mrs F. H. Eaton and Miss Hattie Eaton will arrive probably a week from to-night, to spend the summer in the Bad Lands.
Mr. and Mrs. F. H. Eaton, Miss Hattie, and Mr. Rook arrived from Pittsburgh last evening and this morning started for the Logging Camp where they will spend the summer.
